about.label: About
about.title: About Me
about.text: Senior IT consultant with 25 years of experience in data architecture and business intelligence. I work on enterprise data platforms and lately I've turned my technical curiosity toward applied AI: local systems, multi-agent architectures with persistent memory, automations that orchestrate models and data without relying on third-party cloud infrastructure. Supported languages: English, Italian, Spanish, French, Catalan and Dutch.
